title: Gratitude
definition: Gratitude is the believer's thankful response to God's goodness, grace, provision, salvation, and faithfulness.
summary: Thankfulness turns the heart from entitlement to worship. It remembers what God has done and trusts Him for what is ahead.
christFocus: Christ gives believers every reason for thanksgiving because salvation, forgiveness, and hope are found in Him.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Thankfulness turns the heart from entitlement to worship. It remembers what God has done and trusts Him for what is ahead.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers follow Christ faithfully, understand Scripture clearly, and live with hope, obedience, and discernment.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, bring it into prayer, compare it with Scripture, and let it shape your worship, obedience, endurance, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
